Mɨ tɨkɨ wig hɨriinanɨm sɨma ɨrɨpa kɨmaka haɨngiriyɨu owi Adi Komii siir inɨg ɨiir hainanam, yɨm sɨma hinda yai mɨkrɨmar dwo.
